# MCAT Alphabet Game

The objective of the game is to complete the alphabet using MCAT clues
given for each letter.

## Installation

``` r

remotes::install_github("abo1128/MCATAlphagame")
```

## How to play

In a 180 second time limit, the player gets one clue per letter, and
each clue has a correlated answer. The clues either start with the
letter or contain the certain letter.

## Example

``` r

library(MCATAlphagame)

game <- new_game()
game
play_game(180)
```

The player sees a clue and types the correlated answer

## Functions

- [`new_game()`](https://abo1128.github.io/MCATAlphagame/reference/new_game.md):
  Starts new game
- [`check_answer()`](https://abo1128.github.io/MCATAlphagame/reference/check_answer.md):
  Checks answers of each question
- [`score_game()`](https://abo1128.github.io/MCATAlphagame/reference/score_game.md):
  Amount of correct answers in time allotted
- [`play_game()`](https://abo1128.github.io/MCATAlphagame/reference/play_game.md):
  Play the game
- `mcat_clues`: Gives clues of game for each letter of alphabet

## AI use statement

I used AI to help with some of the code and errors. It explained the
check() notes. I tested and edited the code and can explain it. I wrote
the 26 MCAT clues, the game idea, my own documentation wording, and the
clue wording in play_game. The full list is in AI_USE.md.

  : MCAT Alphabet game

  : Play MCAT alphabet game

  : Prints an MCAT alphabet game
- [`score_game()`](https://abo1128.github.io/MCATAlphagame/reference/score_game.md)
  : Game scoring
